steps.description: cd tasks/end_to_end/gogs/cpu-usage; export T_BENCH_TASK_DOCKER_CLIENT_IMAGE_NAME, T_BENCH_TASK_DOCKER_CLIENT_CONTAINER_NAME, T_BENCH_TEST_DIR, T_BENCH_TASK_LOGS_PATH, T_BENCH_CONTAINER_LOGS_PATH, T_BENCH_TASK_AGENT_LOGS_PATH, T_BENCH_CONTAINER_AGENT_LOGS_PATH.
docker-compose build --no-cache; docker-compose up -d; docker cp tests gogs-client:/tests
docker logs -f gogs-client-client (expect start.sh running, waiting for the server to start).
docker exec -it gogs-client bash; then run ./gogs-build.sh and ./gogs-serve.sh inside the container so the server starts.
Apply solution.sh in the container terminal, then run bash /tests/run-all-tests.sh (or the individual run-build-test.sh / run-monitor-test.sh / run-issue-test.sh / run-testgen-test.sh scripts).
